<page>
 Kennedy & Johnson LLP
 Sugar Land, TX
 Phone 832-555-5054
 Letter of Representation
20 Sep 2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1496
Our client: Tina Woods
Date of loss: 17 Sep 2023
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at an intersection involving your
insured. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and is currently receiving medical care. Pelase direct all further communication
regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whehter by telephone, mail, or in person.
We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the ploicy issued to your insured, including any
applicable umbrella or excess coverage, along with the policy declarations page. We also ask that you identify the claim handler
assgined to this file.
Please ensure that all evidence relating to this loss is preserved. This includes the insured's recorded statements, photographs,
vehicle data and event data recorder information, repair and total-loss appraisals, dash camera footage, telematics records, and
any witness statements or police-related materials in your possession. Any vehicle involved should not be repaired, salvaged, or
disposed of until both parties have had a reasonable opportunity to inspect it.
We look forward to your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
David Richardson
Kennedy & Johnson LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
